# Agility Accountants & Advisors

> CPA-led operational diagnostics and advisory for small businesses in Maryland, Virginia, Washington, DC and Pennsylvania. Agility normalizes a business's financials, benchmarks them against industry-average and best-in-class performance, and delivers a prioritized plan to improve margin and cash flow. Led by Robert O'Connor, CPA, based in Bel Air, Maryland.

Agility Accountants & Advisors is a Bel Air, Maryland accounting and advisory firm. Agility keeps the books each month and turns them into an operational performance analysis: it compares a client's numbers against both the industry average and the best operators in their industry, identifies exactly where the business is losing margin or cash, and delivers a clear, prioritized monthly plan to fix it. The firm is led by Robert O'Connor, a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

Contact: phone +1-410-456-2433, email roconnor@agility-accountants.com, Bel Air, Maryland.

## What makes Agility different
- CPA-led, not a non-credentialed bookkeeping service.
- Benchmarks clients against industry-average AND best-in-class performance, not just generic averages.
- Translates financial data into specific, prioritized operational actions a non-accountant owner can act on.
- Focus on improving margin, cash flow, and confident growth.

## Services
- [Bookkeeping Plans and Pricing](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/pricing.html): Two monthly plans built from bank, card and cash records and reviewed by a CPA. Basic from $325 a month and Advanced from $600 a month, paid annually, for up to 150 transactions and 3 accounts. Advanced adds monthly benchmarking against industry-average and best-in-class operators, a detailed operational analysis and a monthly advisory brief.
- Insight: analysis of books you keep in QuickBooks Online, Xero or FreshBooks, $495 a month or $1,250 a quarter.
- [Profit Leak Assessment](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/pricing.html#assessment): $999 one time, a benchmarked look back at one prior year or up to four quarters with a prioritized fix list.
- [Advisory Partner](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/pricing.html#advisory-partner): the Advanced plan plus quarterly strategy, cash-flow planning, growth modeling and priority access, starting at $2,500 a month with a 12-month minimum term.
- [Operational Analysis & Benchmarking](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/financial-analysis.html): Delivered monthly in the Advanced plan. Normalizes financials, benchmarks against industry-average and best-in-class, and delivers a prioritized improvement plan.
- [Tax Planning](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/plan.html): Year-round tax planning built on the client's actual numbers.
- [Tax Preparation](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Tax preparation for individuals and businesses.
- [Business Formation / Reorganization](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/book-online.html): Guidance on entity structure.
- [Estate Planning](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/services.html): Estate and gift tax planning, coordinated with the client's estate attorney.
- [Business Funding](https://agility-accountants.com/pages/business-funding.html): Referrals to two business funding partners, National Business Capital and SmartBiz Bank. Agility is not a lender or loan broker; the lender pays Agility a referral fee when a referred business is approved for funding, and the business pays Agility nothing for the referral.

## Industries served
Small businesses in Maryland, Virginia, Washington, DC and Pennsylvania across many industries, with particular depth in construction and contractors (job costing, subcontractor analysis, margin benchmarking) and restaurants (prime cost, food and labor cost benchmarking). Also: real estate and property management, specialty trade contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing), home services, multi-unit franchise owners, professional services firms, breweries, wineries and distilleries, auto repair and body shops, dental and medical practices, retail and e-commerce, fitness studios, salons and spas, and child care centers. Full list: https://agility-accountants.com/pages/services.html
